study.question: Does the large item-width by action-width interaction survive when all four native-width cells inherit exactly the same retained initial coordinates from the untrained full16 source, and can any resulting compact model retain source click AUC at lower measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observation: the unchanged source g2-r0004-context_only reaches click AUC0.660646940486458 versus baseline-din0.6555440824200336. Uniform embedding8 (g1-r0006-embedding_half) and dense-half (g1-r0006-dense_half) lose0.00286509 and0.00117365 AUC respectively. Projection/structural-copy branches did not retain source quality: g1-r0010-copy8_interact16 reaches0.65911684. Context8 allocation g1-r0011-context8_item16 reaches0.66009427, but native context8 readout g1-r0012-native_context8_item16 falls to0.65932289; this is not robust retention. Attribute-only8 g1-r0013-id16_attr8 reaches0.65965930, whereas joint item8/action16 reaches0.651350616. Latest factorial: action8 versus16 changes AUC by +0.006573114 at item8 (0.657923730 versus0.651350616), but by -0.001696984 at item16 (0.658949957 versus0.660646940); difference-in-differences is +0.008270098. All reported executions succeeded; these are scientific null/negative outcomes for source retention, not missing data or execution failures. Provisional mechanism explanation: shape-dependent RNG consumption and assignment of embedding/dense initial draws may contribute substantially to the large interaction under the single-pass recipe. Using one full-width random initialization and exact semantic submatrices removes this reassignment without changing each native-width forward operator. Predict reduced item8/action16 collapse and a smaller interaction. This is an initialization-confound hypothesis, not evidence that action information or item capacity is redundant. A smaller candidate may still fail the quality-cost objective.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived primary text lines175-289, especially embedding dictionaries, target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and embedding-size cost discussion. Inherit these established components; add no claim of original attention, compression or dimension-reduction architecture. Current change is prospective initial-coordinate coupling for an existing local source.

Read candidate.py and exact source ancestor. Retain UF summaries, action-aware activation, separate task towers and auxiliary-gradient routing. Change only how scratch initial tensors for each capacity cell are assigned, without learned projection or forward-time padding.

Read standalone native-width implementation and all four trial receipts. Native class methods are AST-identical in the new modules. Add a disposable untrained full16 reference and exact field/block submatrix copy; same-width old trials are initialization replacement controls.

Read primary implementation lines55-160: ordered shared-table ownership, per-field widths, categorical lookup and initialization. Preserve aliases and copied host metadata; use no pretrained data. Source-compatible endpoint and real padding/alias identities must be verified by host.

Read primary constructor, split-optimizer ownership, reset_parameters lines309-323 and device move. Source reset uses Xavier-normal dense weights plus embedding custom initialization; tensor shape changes thus alter draws and fan-in variance. Copy exact unscaled source submatrices instead of silently treating same seed as matched initial values.
Read Dice implementation; copy alpha and all BatchNorm buffers, while preserving inherited primary-only persistent buffer updates. No new activation is introduced.

This earlier structural-copy expansion is not the current change: current native-width cells keep the round14 operator at training and inference. Prior adapter/operator attribution was insufficient for source retention. No novelty claim; nearest broader initialization/pruning literature is not comprehensively verified.

study.proposed_difference: Four-cell item{8,16} x action{8,16} native-width factorial with source-coupled initialization. Each standalone Model first constructs the identical full16 untrained CPU _NativeModel using incoming host RNG state. Reduced construction is isolated with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]). Copy each embedding table prefix, the retained semantic field coordinates in the scorer query/key/difference/product/action blocks, and context/target/pooled/action tower blocks; copy all other parameters and state buffers unchanged. Do not rescale first-layer submatrices. Discard the reference; no extra persistent parameter, training pass or inference computation. Full16 endpoint should be tensor- and RNG-identical to original source construction. This is a diagnostic intervention on model initialization, not an optimizer, seed, data or scoring contract change.
predictions: Required compatibility gate: coupled_item16_action16 exactly matches the original full16 source state, probabilities and post-construction CPU RNG under paired incoming state. All persistent parameter counts match round14 cells: item8/action8=19863797;16/8=32055709;8/16=19868541;16/16=32060453. The reference is absent from named parameters/state after construction.

Conditional on gates, coupled_item8_action16 should improve over g1-r0014-item8_action16_control, and absolute interaction I=(AUC8/8-AUC8/16)-(AUC16/8-AUC16/16) should shrink by at least50% versus the historical0.008270098 as an exploratory discriminating criterion. This threshold is a prospective diagnostic, not a significance claim.

All compact cells preserve their round14 inference operator and parameter counts, so initialization alone predicts no systematic latency change at fixed shape. Item8 cells should retain their measured lower model batch latency relative to co-run full16; actual loader-inclusive throughput may not improve.

Provisional efficiency screen: an item8 cell must lose no more than0.0005 click AUC versus co-run full16, reduce measured total parameters by at least20%, and lower both model-only batch p50/p95 by at least5% at8192 before advancing. Report training/construction costs and end-to-end inference separately. Retention is preliminary at one seed; require later paired-seed and user-cluster uncertainty before a robust claim.
falsifiers: If full16 state/output/RNG parity, table aliases, fixed sample information or training exposure fail, classify the experiment as an invalid implementation/contract diagnostic and stop comparison; this does not falsify capacity efficiency.

If coupled initials leave the item8/action16 collapse and interaction magnitude largely unchanged, the shape-driven random-draw reassignment explanation is weakened in this implementation. A single seed does not refute all initialization effects.
If all compact cells remain more than0.0005 click AUC below full16, no source-quality retention is supported in this tested range even if performance exceeds baseline-din.

If smaller persistent models do not reduce model inference latency, or construction/training/end-to-end costs erase the practical benefit, the corresponding efficiency claim fails. AUC recovery without cost benefit is not success.
If later paired seeds/cluster intervals contradict retention or the interaction explanation, revise the provisional conclusion and retain these outcomes.
alternative_explanations: Reducing actual representation rank, dense fan-in and omitted signal can cause a real capacity interaction even when retained coordinates match.

Exact source submatrices have full16 Xavier scaling, whereas native narrower matrices use their own fan-in scale. The replacement jointly changes draw assignment and initial first-layer variance; recovery alone cannot distinguish these effects. A variance-matched replacement control is the next falsifiable follow-up if consequential.

Dice normalization, nonlinear optimization, clipped dense gradients and one-epoch sparse adaptation can amplify small initial differences. This study cannot identify a semantic role for actions from AUC alone.

The shared source initialization is one random seed and a deterministic prefix coordinate choice, not a representative sample of initializations or learned pruning. Existing exact replays are execution checks, not repetitions.
Shared-table aliases may constrain field capacity; reject unsupported layouts rather than silently changing ownership. Raw user IDs, timestamps and current labels remain unavailable.

Loader overhead and device timing variation explain differences between model-only latency and loader-inclusive throughput; source replay times already vary. Require measured costs, with repeated timed passes only if the authorized host interface supports and charges them.
